news.title: 10M expansion state adults risk losing Medicaid coverage over inconsistent work hours
news.summary: About 20% of adults living in Medicaid expansion states will have their eligibility threatened because their work hours may be insufficient or inconsistent under incoming national work requirements, a new study suggests.

news.title: White House unveils next round of MFN pricing deals with 9 midsized drugmakers
news.summary: Some four months after the White House inked the last of its expected drug pricing deals with 17 of the industry’s top players, the U.S. government is back for round 2, this time lining up agreements with a host of medium-sized biopharmas under President Trump’s ‘most favored nation’ agenda.

news.title: McKesson confirms cybersecurity incident as hackers claim millions of patient records stolen
news.summary: Healthcare giant McKesson Corporation confirmed on Friday that it was investigating a cybersecurity incident tied to third-party applications that led to unauthorized access and theft of data.

news.title: Chutes & Ladders—Centene names new CIO; Elevance Health taps new behavioral health leader
news.summary: Welcome to this week's Chutes & Ladders, our roundup of hirings, firings and retirings throughout the industry. Please submit the good news—or the bad—from your shop, and we will feature it here at the end of each week.

news.title: Revenues grow, margins slow at Advocate Health in H1 2026
news.summary: The major nonprofit system reported an 8.6% year-over-year increase in operating revenues, though its operating margin dipped from 4.4% to 3.8%.

news.title: Docs are seeing more patients influenced by mis- and disinformation. What can they do about it?
news.summary: More docs surveyed in March said their patients were influenced by inaccurate info than in 2025, and that it is affecting their care.

news.title: Sanford Health, North Memorial Health deal to move forward under oversight agreement with Minnesota AG
news.summary: The deal, expected to close later this year, is another attempt from the major rural nonprofit system to enter the Minneapolis market. To do so, it plans a $600 million investment into the two-hospital North Memorial Health, which will help stabilize one financially strained safety-net facility and double the size of the other.

news.title: How Shared Clinical Decision-Making Can Shape the Metastatic Prostate Cancer Journey
news.summary: When a patient learns they have metastatic castration-sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC), it often marks the beginning of a long and uncertain journey. The first conversations that follow can shape how that patient feels about their treatment and their role in it. In those early moments, how we respond matters.

news.title: In next phase of sustainability, UCI Health, Kaiser Permanente, and others turn to electric hospitals
news.summary: The U.S. healthcare sector is responsible for about 9% of the country’s greenhouse gas emissions. A growing number of providers have implemented sustainability agendas, with electrification being the next frontier.

news.title: Maryland sues Optum over 'defective' computer system
news.summary: Maryland has filed a lawsuit against UnitedHealth Group, alleging that its Optum unit defrauded the state's Medicaid program by providing a faulty computer system.

news.title: Florida AG sues Prime Therapeutics, Express Scripts for alleged price-fixing
news.summary: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier is suing Express Scripts and Prime Therapeutics, alleging that a partnership between the two pharmacy benefit managers allows them to illegally fix prices.

news.title: UPDATED: Novartis halts autoimmune CAR-T trials after 3 deaths, as BMS also pauses studies
news.summary: Three deaths have forced Novartis to pause development of its CD19 CAR-T candidate in autoimmune diseases, just as Bristol Myers Squibb has halted a similar program due to immune-related adverse events, Fierce has learned.

news.title: Natera teams with Angiex on cancer drug trial monitoring
news.summary: Natera inked a collaboration deal with biotech Angiex to assess the use of its Signatera blood test, which looks for small traces of cancer DNA in patients who have been diagnosed and treated for the disease.

news.title: Electra aims to light up Nasdaq with IPO for phase 2/3 I&I push
news.summary: The 2026 IPO streak continues as Electra Therapeutics has filed to go public to support its immunology and cancer pipeline.

news.title: ESC26: AstraZeneca's heart failure drug shows promise in ph. 2 trial
news.summary: AstraZeneca’s oral relaxin agonist delivered encouraging phase 2b results in chronic heart failure, improving measures of cardiac function across two patient groups.

news.title: Eli Lilly inks $2.88B Merida buyout for autoimmune drugs against rogue antibodies
news.summary: Eli Lilly has struck a deal to acquire Merida Biosciences for up to $2.875 billion, establishing a beachhead in efforts to treat disease through the selective degradation of pathogenic autoantibodies.

news.title: Beyond the Bandwidth Ceiling: Redesigning Advanced Therapy Operating Models for the Digital Staff Era
news.summary: Advanced therapy manufacturers are hitting a bandwidth ceiling. Deloitte makes the case for redesigning ops around AI 'digital staff.'

news.title: China in Global Clinical Development: Why Early Inclusion Matters
news.summary: Leading biotechs are rethinking China’s role in global clinical development. Early inclusion can unlock significant value.

news.title: BioNTech-Genentech cancer vax records more deaths than control in scrapped ph. 2 test
news.summary: Following Merck and Moderna’s phase 3 triumph with a Keytruda-paired personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, a similar shot from BioNTech and Genentech has faltered in a reminder of the approach’s struggles as a standalone therapy.

news.summary: AusperBio Therapeutics has raised $120 million in series C funds to advance its oligonucleotide therapy for chronic hepatitis B through phase 3 testing and hopefully on to commercialization.

papers.title: Acquire, Repair, Preserve: A Diagnosis-Guided Post-Training Recipe for Small-Model Dialogue Game Agents
papers.summary: Interactive dialogue games test a capability that static benchmarks largely leave implicit: a model must carry state across turns, interpret feedback, and choose valid actions under changing constraints. We study this setting in the LM Playschool Challenge with a 2B open-weight model, and find that many failures are not only broad knowledge failures but also local decision failures: repeated guesses, malformed actions, and violations of feedback that the model has just seen. papers.title: EvoUndo: Recoverability-Constrained Self-Evolution for LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.summary: LLM agents increasingly modify their own prompts, tools, middleware, resources, and execution harnesses at runtime. Such self-evolution can improve capability, but a successful mutation may leave persistent effects that cannot be safely reversed in states different from the one in which it was created. We introduce EvoUndo, a framework for representing, synthesizing, diagnosing, and independently verifying recoverability of model-generated self-modifications across counterfactual states.
